metadata.title: Post a task | Slashie
metadata.description: Post a Slashie task with details, timing, budget, contact preference, and location.

en.missingDetails: Some details are missing. We've taken you to the first one.
en.loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.

location.label: Location
location.title: Where is the task?
location.description: Move the map so the pin sits near the job. Workers only see this approximate area, not your address.

address.label: Address
address.title: What's the exact address?
address.description: Only shared with the worker you accept, after you accept their quote.

details.label: Details
details.title: What needs doing?
details.description: A clear title and a few lines help workers quote.

timing.label: Timing
timing.title: When do you need it?
timing.description: Keep it flexible or pick a date. You agree the final time with your worker.

budget.label: Budget
budget.title: What's your budget?
budget.description: A realistic budget gets better quotes. You pay your worker directly.

review.label: Review
review.title: Check and post
review.description: This is how workers will see your task.

location.searchPlaceholder: Search a street, area, or postcode
location.locateUnavailable: We couldn't get your location. Search or drag the map instead.
location.privacyCallout: Your exact address stays private until you accept a worker. Until then, workers only see the town and a map point within about 250 m.
location.areaPending: Move the map to set the area.
location.addressHelper: Shared only with the worker you accept.
location.mapUnavailable: The map isn't available right now. Type the address instead.

fields.title: Task title
fields.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Fix a leaking kitchen tap
fields.categoriesHelper: Tap a suggestion or type your own. Up to 10.
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: What's the job, and anything a worker should know?
fields.photosHelper: Photos help workers quote. They're public on your task, so leave out house numbers and faces.
fields.tooManyPhotos: You can add up to {max} photos.
fields.photoTooLarge: {name} is over {size} MB, so it wasn't added.
fields.notAPhoto: {name} isn't a photo, so it wasn't added.
fields.photoTypeUnsupported: {name} wasn't added. Use a JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or AVIF photo.
fields.contact: How should your worker reach you?
fields.contactHelper: Shared only with the worker you accept.
fields.phoneLocked: Verify your phone in Account to use this.
fields.emailLocked: Verify your email in Account to use this.
fields.allowedBody: Do not post illegal, unsafe, or licensed work unless the worker holds the right credentials. Slashie does not vet listings.
fields.allowedConfirm: I confirm this task is legal, and I will not ask for unsafe or unlicensed work.

verify.title: Verify your email to post
verify.body: Open the link we sent to {email}, then tap I've verified.
verify.notYet: Your email isn't verified yet. Check your inbox and spam folder.

errors.areaRequired: Search or move the map to set the area.
errors.mapUnreadable: We couldn't read the map. Move it slightly and try again.
errors.dateInPast: Pick today or a later date.
errors.dateInvalid: That date isn't valid. Pick another.
errors.timeInvalid: Pick a valid date and time.
errors.consentRequired: Tick the box to confirm this task is allowed.
errors.tooManyCategories: You can add up to 10 categories.
errors.placeNotFound: We couldn't find that place. Search again or move the map to set the pin.
errors.locationMissing: Search or move the map to set the area.
errors.mapUnavailable: We couldn't reach the map. Check your connection and try again.
errors.postFailed: We couldn't post your task. Try again.
errors.verifyEmail: Verify your email before you post.
errors.verifyPhone: Verify your phone in Account, or choose another way to be reached.
errors.photosFailed: Your task is posted, but {count} photos didn't upload
errors.photoFailed: Your task is posted, but 1 photo didn't upload
errors.photosFailedBody: Add them from Edit task on your task.

serverErrors.DATE_REQUIRED: Pick a date for this task.
serverErrors.INVALID_DATE: That date isn't valid. Pick another.
serverErrors.DATE_IN_PAST: That date has passed in the UK. Pick today or a later date.

metadata.title: 發佈任務 | Slashie
metadata.description: 在 Slashie 發佈任務，加入詳情、時間、預算、聯絡偏好和地點。

photoProgress.preparing: 正在準備第 {index} 張相片（共 {total} 張）
photoProgress.uploading: 正在上載第 {index} 張相片（共 {total} 張）

zh_hk.missingDetails: 部分資料未填好，已帶你到第一項。

location.label: 地點
location.title: 任務在哪裡？
location.description: 移動地圖，把圖釘放在工作地點附近。工作者只會看到這個大約位置，不會看到你的地址。

address.label: 地址
address.title: 工作的詳細地址是？
address.description: 只會在你接受報價後，分享給你選擇的工作者。

details.label: 詳情
details.title: 需要做甚麼？
details.description: 清楚的標題和幾句說明，有助工作者報價。

timing.label: 時間
timing.title: 你甚麼時候需要？
timing.description: 可以保持彈性，或揀一個日期。最終時間會與工作者再商量。

budget.label: 預算
budget.title: 你的預算是多少？
budget.description: 合理的預算會帶來更好的報價。你會直接付款給工作者。

review.label: 檢查
review.title: 檢查並發佈
review.description: 這是工作者會看到的任務。

location.searchPlaceholder: 搜尋街道、地區或郵遞區號
location.locateUnavailable: 無法取得你的位置，請搜尋或拖動地圖。
location.privacyCallout: 在你接受工作者之前，你的確實地址會保密。在此之前，工作者只會看到地區名稱，以及約 250 米範圍內的地圖位置。
location.addressHelper: 只會分享給你接受的工作者。
location.mapUnavailable: 地圖暫時未能使用，請直接輸入地址。

draft.restored: 我們保留了你未完成的任務。

fields.title: 任務標題
fields.titlePlaceholder: 例如：修理漏水的廚房水龍頭
fields.categoriesHelper: 點選建議或自行輸入，最多 10 個。
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: 要做甚麼工作？有甚麼工作者需要知道？
fields.photosHelper: 相片有助工作者報價。相片會在任務中公開，請避免拍到門牌號碼和人臉。
fields.savedPhoto: 已儲存的第 {number} 張相片
fields.tooManyPhotos: 最多可加入 {max} 張相片。
fields.photoTypeUnsupported: {name} 未有加入。請使用 JPG、PNG、WebP、HEIC 或 AVIF 相片。
fields.contactHelper: 只會分享給你接受的工作者。
fields.phoneLocked: 請先在帳戶中驗證電話，才可使用此選項。
fields.emailLocked: 請先在帳戶中驗證電郵，才可使用此選項。
fields.allowedBody: 請勿發布非法、不安全的工作，或在對方沒有所需資格時要求持牌工作。Slashie 不會審查刊登內容。
fields.allowedConfirm: 我確認此任務合法，且不會要求不安全或無牌的工作。

verify.title: 請先驗證電郵才可發佈
verify.body: 打開我們寄到 {email} 的連結，然後按「我已驗證」。
verify.notYet: 你的電郵尚未驗證，請檢查收件匣和垃圾郵件。

errors.areaRequired: 請搜尋或移動地圖以設定地區。
errors.mapUnreadable: 未能讀取地圖，請稍為移動地圖再試。
errors.dateInPast: 請揀選今日或之後的日期。
errors.dateInvalid: 這個日期無效，請揀選另一日。
errors.timeInvalid: 請揀選有效的日期和時間。
errors.consentRequired: 請剔選方格，確認此任務屬於允許範圍。
errors.tooManyCategories: 最多可加入 10 個類別。
errors.categoryTooLong: 每個類別請少於 64 個字元。
errors.placeNotFound: 找不到該地點。請重新搜尋，或移動地圖設定圖釘。
errors.locationMissing: 請搜尋或移動地圖以設定地區。
errors.mapUnavailable: 未能連接地圖，請檢查網絡連線再試。
errors.postFailed: 未能發佈你的任務，請再試一次。
errors.verifyPhone: 請在帳戶中驗證電話，或選擇其他聯絡方式。
errors.photosFailed: 任務已發佈，但有 {count} 張相片未能上載
errors.photoFailed: 任務已發佈，但有 1 張相片未能上載
errors.photosFailedBody: 請在任務頁按「編輯任務」再加入。

serverErrors.DATE_REQUIRED: 請為這個任務揀選日期。
serverErrors.INVALID_DATE: 這個日期無效，請揀選另一日。
serverErrors.DATE_IN_PAST: 按英國時間，這個日期已過。請揀選今日或之後的日期。
